author: root release integration and prior release-control authors

acceptanceReview.acceptance: Record actual namespace/package history/collision checks and lower-semver reset migration. Unknown registry access is a recorded publish blocker, not available.
acceptanceReview.basis: The pinned release toolchain authenticated as arconath, npm reports arconath as owner of aeliqo with auth-and-writes 2FA, all six sdk-* identities and exact 0.1.0/0.1.0-rc.1 queries returned E404, and the incompatible @aeliqo/core and @aeliqo/react 0.2.0 histories remain visible. The migration document treats first-publication acceptance as unknown rather than available.

acceptanceReview.acceptance: Exact target 0.1.0 retained; previously published identities not overwritten/unpublished to reset; staging tags/rollback/cleanup allowlist documented.
acceptanceReview.basis: All six public local package manifests remain exact 0.1.0; the release controls restrict first bootstrap to 0.1.0-rc.1 on next, stable to rewrite, and exact six-package dependency order. The migration chapter preserves old artifacts and rollback, prohibits unpublish as collision recovery, and requires explicit cleanup targets.

controlReview.collision: Registry classifiers fail closed on non-404 errors and reject existing candidate versions with different bytes.
controlReview.unpublishNonReuse: The canonical migration contract states that a published name/version cannot be reused after unpublish and prohibits unpublish as reset recovery.
controlReview.firstRcBootstrap: The owner bootstrap is restricted to an interactive local terminal, exact actor/org-owner/TFA authority, the exact 0.1.0-rc.1 version, next tag, unused identities or byte-identical partial-publication resume.
controlReview.nonlatestTags: RC is restricted to next; initial stable is restricted to rewrite; latest promotion is a separate deliberate operation.
controlReview.exactPackageSet: The candidate and approved-RC validators require each of the six sdk-* packages exactly once in dependency order and bind tarball bytes/integrities.
controlReview.rollbackAndCleanup: Existing consumers, release artifacts, data, credentials, and rollback references are retained; production cleanup requires an explicit reviewed target list after rollback identity is secured.

scenarioReview.assertion: Used name/version blocks publication; unavailable registry remains unknown. Unpublish does not free version.
scenarioReview.basis: The documented policy and executable release-tooling tests enforce all three clauses. Current E404 observations are recorded only as not visible.

scope: Approves the exact 0.1.0 reset policy, authenticated namespace authority, current registry observations, and fail-closed publication controls at the prepublication ready stage. It does not approve or claim RC/stable publication, dist-tag promotion, GitHub release, deployment, historical non-use, or npm first-publication availability.
